question_text: Construct an SQL query returning SupplierID and ProductName for products whose Description contains "fruity" and whose stock quantity is 25–35 inclusive. Tables: Product(ProductID, SupplierID, ProductName, Description), Stock(ProductID, Quantity). Join using ProductID.
adaptation_rationale: Add required two-table join while preserving range/substring query reasoning. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
